newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK property deals in April rise 66 pct in value.
newsitem.headline: HK property deals in April rise 66 pct in value.

text.p: Hong Kong recorded 25,572 sale and purchase agreements worth HK$107.87 billion in April for residential and non-residential properties, the government Land Registry said on Wednesday.
The value of the agreements rose 66.2 percent from March and 265.2 percent from April last year, the registry said in a statement.
The number of deals increased 58.6 percent from March and 166.2 percent from April 1996, it said.
